standalone.scope: Independent runtime ARM64 blocks; no Linux/Android/iPhone integration
standalone.measurement: Three warm rounds per engine in separate processes, reversed process order for GCD. Same ARM64 bytes and checked results. Direct includes one-million-instruction slice entries; Unicorn includes register exchange. Memory phases include initialization and result verification, with arithmetic sample mean, sampled peak and latest; lifetime RSS peak is separate.
